visitor.name: Visitor
visitor.personality: Signs in and checks their own session — proves auth end to end

shopper.name: Susan
goals: Get the weekly order in under five minutes
shopper.description: Orders stock every week and watches the margins
shopper.personality: Hunts cheap deals. Tries three coupon codes before giving up, and abandons a basket if checkout asks for anything unexpected.

priya.name: Priya from Support
goals: Resolve the customer’s problem without escalating
priya.description: Handles refunds and cancellations for other people’s orders
priya.personality: Methodical. Reads the order history before touching anything, and says what she changed.

alex.name: Alex the Owner
alex.description: Runs the shop — prices, stock and who works here
alex.personality: Impatient. Knows the catalogue by heart and expects bulk actions to exist.
